The glyph height grid records invariant-format estimates at width, glyph-count and script branch boundaries, to four decimal places.

`character-flags.bin` holds the Unicode 15 letter, decimal digit and whitespace flags of every UTF-16 code unit, in ascending order: bit 0 is letter, bit 1 is decimal digit, bit 2 is whitespace. `latin-fold.json` records FormD accent folding over U+00C0–U+024F and U+1E00–U+1EFF. Both were recorded on 2026-10-30; they guard character semantics across languages and Unicode libraries.
